input.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months of fees
input.comment: [Playbook] The 90-day mutual termination right in Section 4.1 works for us, but the Section 4.2 Termination Payment is an uncapped share of twelve months' Net Sales, which penalises us for leaving. We have added a cap of three months' fees under Section 3.1, which is our fallback position on early-termination fees.

ops.text: In no event shall the Termination Payment exceed the aggregate payments due from the Company to HDI pursuant to Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date.
